info.title: Enterprise Banking & Commerce Platform API
info.description: Comprehensive enterprise specification covering all banking and financial rails.

tags.name: accounts
tags.description: Manage retail and commercial checking, savings, and investment accounts.

tags.name: transactions
tags.description: Query, post, and reconcile debit and credit ledger transactions.

tags.name: cards
tags.description: Virtual and physical card provisioning, lifecycle, and transaction controls.

tags.name: payments
tags.description: Real-time payment rails, ACH, SEPA, and wire transfer processing.

tags.name: transfers
tags.description: Internal account-to-account and scheduled recurrent fund movements.

tags.name: customers
tags.description: Demographics, KYC status, customer profiles, and onboarding records.

tags.name: loans
tags.description: Personal, mortgage, and small business loan origination and servicing.

tags.name: investments
tags.description: Stock, bond, ETF portfolio management, trading, and order routing.

tags.name: insurance
tags.description: Policy underwriting, premium billing, and claim adjudication.

tags.name: fraud
tags.description: Real-time behavioral scoring, AML screening, and alert triage.

tags.name: notifications
tags.description: Omnichannel alerts including push, SMS, email, and secure inbox.

tags.name: statements
tags.description: Monthly e-statements, regulatory disclosures, and tax reporting.

tags.name: merchants
tags.description: Merchant onboarding, POS terminal configuration, and payment gateway.

tags.name: settlements
tags.description: Interbank settlement batching, net obligations, and liquidity buffers.

tags.name: disputes
tags.description: Evidence collection, arbitration workflow, and cardholder disputes.

tags.name: subscriptions
tags.description: Scheduled recurring billers, subscription tiers, and dunning cycles.

tags.name: wallets
tags.description: Apple Pay, Google Pay token provisioning, and stored-value balances.

tags.name: kyc
tags.description: Document verification, facial biometrics match, and sanction list checks.

tags.name: beneficiaries
tags.description: Trusted third-party payees, bank routing directories, and validation.

tags.name: fx
tags.description: Real-time spot quotes, forward contracts, and currency conversion.
